svg.aria-label: Start with a labor gap. Is time on your side? If yes, hire locally. If no: can the local market supply the skills? If yes, local hire or an agency. If no: is the gap large or time-critical? If yes, travel labor. If no, an agency or overtime, short term.
svg.title: Which play fits your gap?
svg.desc: Start with a labor gap. Is time on your side? If yes, hire locally. If no: can the local market supply the skills? If yes, local hire or an agency. If no: is the gap large or time-critical? If yes, travel labor. If no, an agency or overtime, short term.
